cards.headline:
Five o'clock
was a fight
in our house
cards.body: For about two years. Here is what we did in the end.

cards.name: the-problem
cards.headline:
Two more
minutes
becomes
twenty.
cards.body: And then it is a row, and the row ruins the evening.

cards.name: say-this
cards.headline: The handover
cards.not: Right, that is enough, off it now.
cards.say: Your timer has four minutes left. Do you want to finish the level or stop at a save point?

cards.name: ages
cards.headline:
It is not one
rule for all

bands.what: You hold the timer. The job is a calm stop, every time, with no negotiation.
They ask, you say yes or not yet. They start watching the clock themselves.
They set it and you see it. You step in on the pattern, not on the day.

cards.name: the-hinge
cards.quote: The minutes were earned. So the timer ending is a deal running out, not you being mean.
cards.attrib: Real jobs pay stars. Stars buy the minutes.

cards.name: ask
cards.headline: Keep this one
cards.save: Save it for five o'clock today, because that is when you will want the words.
cards.send: Send it to the parent who says the same thing every evening and hates it.
